files.description: Website clicks (500 rows): click_ref (seven-digit reference with leading zeros, e.g. "0000011"), epoch_s (Unix timestamp in seconds, UTC, whole number), epoch_ms (Unix timestamp in milliseconds, UTC, when the click was received, whole number), page (site path such as /home or /pricing), dwell_s (seconds on the page, one decimal; about 8% empty).

task_text: Read the clicks file keeping every column as text, so that click_ref keeps its leading zeros. Then turn epoch_s (Unix time in seconds) into a date-time, treating values that cannot be converted as missing, and count the clicks per calendar day (UTC). `result` should be a Series indexed by day (text 'YYYY-MM-DD') with the click counts, in day order.
intended_computation: All epoch_s values are valid whole numbers, so every click converts; count the 500 clicks per UTC calendar day and index the counts by 'YYYY-MM-DD', ascending.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x digit strings given with a seconds unit are parsed as date text, fail and become missing, so no clicks are counted

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
